title: Normalised EMG of 14 trunk sites during maximal exertions (extension, flexion, right lateral bend, left twist), standing, young men

source.authors: Thelen DG, Schultz AB, Ashton-Miller JA
source.sample: 9 subjects (9 M); healthy young men, university staff/students, no back injury

quantity.name: normalised RMS EMG at MVC
quantity.definition: 50-ms moving RMS, normalised to the maximum mean RMS of that muscle over the six maximum static exertions (flexion, extension, R/L lateral bending, CW/CCW twisting); value at the maximum exertion

protocol.summary: Upright standing in a test frame restraining the lower body (pelvic support on force plate, feet on force plate); padded restraints around the upper body just below shoulder level; hands on handles slightly anterior and lateral to the shoulders. Six 2-s maximum static voluntary exertions: flexion, extension, right and left lateral bending, counter-clockwise and clockwise twisting. Net moments computed at the L3-L4 disc centre from two force plates (lower-body static analysis) - not L5-S1. Surface bipolar electrodes (10-mm Ag discs, 20 mm apart) bilaterally on 7 sites. Only 4 of the 6 MVC directions shown in Fig 2.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax restrained by pads just below shoulder level
Maximal voluntary exertion in extension, flexion, right lateral bending, left axial rotation (CCW twist)
Extract activations at the 14 electrode sites (RA, IO, EO, ES at L3-L4 2/4/6 cm lateral, LD at T10; both sides)
Normalise each site by its maximum over the 6 model MVCs; compare with mean ± SD (moments at L3-L4)
protocol.notes: Twist direction: counter-clockwise (assumed viewed from above) = left axial rotation, consistent with right EO / left IO / left LD being most active. MVC moment magnitudes NOT reported (only cyclic 2/3-max peaks: flexion 42-54, extension 81-85, lateral 52-59, twist 47-50 Nm; = 68/67/72/72 % of MVC). Off-axis moments during cyclic exertions < 12 Nm on average. Values slightly >100 clipped to 100.

extraction.check_notes: Pixel extraction of bar tops and SD caps (central columns). Right lateral bend panel re-digitised at 300 dpi: all 14 bars within 0.4 % (e.g. R ESI 65.0 vs 65.2, L LD 42.4 vs 42.2). Left ESM bar in extension read manually (outline top at 100.0, SD not visible). sd null = SD bar not visible.
